title: Light with steel wool
kid_text: A grown-up touches the wool to the cell.
safety: The wool flares fast. Keep it off your face.

steps.text: Pull a thin wisp of steel wool.
Lay that wisp on the tinder.
Touch both ends of the cell to the wool.
Let the flare fall into the nest.
Keep the cell away from your face.

mistakes.text: You hold the wool near your face.
mistakes.fix: Point it down into the nest.

mistakes.text: The wool is a thick pad.
mistakes.fix: Pull it into a thin wisp.
